title: A COM-style interface
description:
Write an interface with a vtable, reference counting and `QueryInterface`.

```
create Shape -> refs 1
QueryInterface(IID_IArea) -> ok, refs 2
area = 12
Release, Release -> refs 0, destroyed
QueryInterface(IID_IUnknownThing) -> E_NOINTERFACE
```
hints: The destructor is protected so nobody can `delete` through the interface; only `Release` frees the object (lesson 3.04).
requirements: `struct IUnknownLike { virtual int QueryInterface(int iid, void** out) = 0; virtual unsigned AddRef() = 0; virtual unsigned Release() = 0; };`
An `IArea : IUnknownLike` interface with `virtual double Area() = 0;` and a class implementing both.
`Release` deletes the object when the count reaches 0; `QueryInterface` calls `AddRef` on success.
stretch: Write a small smart pointer like `ComPtr<T>` that calls `AddRef` and `Release` for you.
